raw: | A `mxcli test` case written with a bare `@throws` reports **FAIL … exception during execution** — it fails on the very error it was written to expect — and separately, `@throws 'ZZZ-NOT-THE-REAL-MESSAGE'` reports **PASS** | Both generators keyed a throws test on `tc.Throws != ""`, and a bare annotation leaves `Throws` empty — the same value an ABSENT annotation leaves, so the two states were indistinguishable and the bare form was dropped in silence. The message half was decorative: the generated `ON ERROR` handler cleared the pre-set failing verdict for **any** exception, so a stale or simply wrong expectation kept passing against a completely different error. The regexp required the quotes, so an unquoted message matched nothing and removed the `@throws` entirely | `cmd/mxcli/testrunner/parser.go` (`parseThrows`, `TestCase.ExpectsThrow`, `expectsThrow()`), `generator_endpoint.go` (`throwsHandler`), `generator.go` (`throwsFlagHandler`) | **`$latestError/Message` is available inside an `ON ERROR` handler and compiles** — measured at 0 errors on mxbuild 11.6.0 and 11.13.0, with `$noSuchThing/Message` as the control (**CE0109** "Undefined variable"). Match with `contains`, not equality: a real Mendix message carries an activity name or an object id the test cannot predict (`Could not find object of type 'RtMap.Person'`), so equality would make most expectations unwritable. Two fields can say "this is a throws test" and they must not disagree — read them through **one accessor** (`ExpectsThrow || Throws != ""`), or every existing construction site that sets only the message silently becomes a non-throws test. Prove it at RUNTIME, not on the generated MDL: the control (`if want == ""` → `if true`, rebuilt) reproduces both reported symptoms verbatim against `mdl-examples/bug-tests/mapping-runtime-proof.test.mdl` under `run --local --test-endpoint` + `test --attach`. That suite's own `@throws 'the object was not found'` was **wrong and passing** — a fixed matcher turns a wrong expectation red, so expect to correct existing tests. ako/mxcli#301 |
